title: Stained Glass Cosmic Selfie
description: A vibrant digital artwork framed as a stained glass window set against a starry nebula background. A woman with long purple hair, wearing a brown and neon green bikini, sits on an ornate bed taking a selfie with a smartphone while surrounded by glowing pink energy rays and sun motifs.
prompt: A surreal digital painting styled as an ornate stained glass window set in a cosmic nebula background. A fit woman with long flowing purple hair and body paint sits on a luxurious patterned bed wearing a brown and neon green bikini. She holds a smartphone taking a selfie, surrounded by radiant pink energy beams, a glowing sun symbol on her chest, and intricate stained glass panels featuring suns, flowers, and symbolic icons.
